JP.feeBasis: The Certificate of Eligibility for Entertainer status is free; the single-entry visa that follows costs about ¥15,000 from July 1, 2026 (¥3,000 until then).
JP.daysBasis: New Certificates of Eligibility for Entertainer status took 18 days on average over 31 months to July 2026, by the Immigration Services Agency's statistics.

sources.what: Japan COE processing times from the Ministry of Justice's statistics: Entertainer, new, 18.0 days (to July 2026)
Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan: visa fees from July 1, 2026, about ¥15,000 single entry, ¥30,000 multiple

IN.feeBasis: An employment visa valid for a year, multiple entries, at the Embassy of India in Argentina's chart from July 1, 2026 ($120 for six months); fees differ by nationality.
IN.daysBasis: Usually five working days from submission of a complete application.
IN.stayBasis: The employment visa charged is valid for a year.

sources.what: Embassy of India in Argentina, fees from July 1, 2026: employment visa, one year, USD 200

ZA.feeBasis: The non-refundable application fee for a visitor's visa with section 11(2) work authorisation at the South African Embassy in Washington (April 2026); fees differ by mission.
ZA.stayBasis: A section 11(2) visa does not exceed 90 days, and the work is limited to 180 days a calendar year.

sources.what: South African Embassy in Washington, section 11(2) visitor's visa for short-term work (April 2026): $55, seven to ten business days

HK.feeBasis: The application fee for a specified admission scheme such as the General Employment Policy, HK$600, and the visa for a stay of 181 days or more, HK$1,300 (HK$600 for 180 days or less), from February 26, 2025.
HK.daysBasis: Normally four weeks once the Immigration Department has every document and the fee.
HK.stayBasis: An initial stay of 36 months on employment, or the contract's length if shorter.

sources.what: Hong Kong government, February 26, 2025: a $600 application fee for the specified schemes, the General Employment Policy among them, and a visa fee of $600 or $1,300 by the limit of stay

SG.stayBasis: A first-time Employment Pass runs up to two years.
